metadata.title: The Dehn–Hadwiger Invariant in Four Dimensions: Lean 4 formalization (PALOMAR registration pending)
metadata.description:
Lean 4 formalization accompanying DICTO's paper #116, The Dehn–Hadwiger Invariant in Four Dimensions (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24393967). It proves: The Dehn–Hadwiger invariant defined from the set alone, in every finite-dimensional real inner product space: scissors-congruent convex polytopes, and finite unions of them, have the same invariant in every dimension; its values on the six regular 4-polytopes (0 for the tesseract, 16-cell, 24-cell and 120-cell; nonzero for the 5-cell and the 600-cell, of opposite signs); and the resulting non-congruences between similar copies of these polytopes.

Built with Lean 4 (leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0-rc2) with Mathlib at commit 0653561 (tag v4.35.0-rc2). This archive is the GitHub repository DICTOR-Master/dehn-hadwiger-4d-lean at commit 5a2cf4ca1b3a5f14f9e2cfd5596189219bdd31e9, submitted for registration in the Palomar registry at this commit; every proof is checked by the Lean kernel.
